description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the AttendanceRecordAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains tests for API endpoints related to attendance records, including methods to test retrieval, update, and mock setup for workflow permissions.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AttendanceRecordAPI endpoints related to attendance records in OrangeHRM. It includes data providers and setup for permission workflows.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API endpoint for retrieving a single attendance record.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetOne' from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the 'update' API endpoint for modifying an attendance record.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testUpdate' from a YAML data source.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Sets up workflow rules allowing users to modify attendance records.

methods.name: enableSupervisorCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Sets up workflow rules allowing supervisors to modify attendance records.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete operation is not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the validation rule for delete is not implemented and throws the expected exception.
